screens.title: Gun setup
screens.entry: First visit without a gun; Add/Edit from My Guns
screens.notes: Name (1–80 characters), three illustrated native radio choices for gun type, five-gun capacity, local-storage explanation and Save. Existing-gun Edit prefills the same form with Save Changes and Cancel; saving retains gun identity and all data without changing active selection. First use offers Restore from backup.

screens.title: Home
screens.entry: After gun selection/setup and returning visits
screens.notes: Compact DF / WITH EASE header, Settings gear, illustrated active-gun switcher with the selected type, Learn/Drills/Live Listen/History cards and gun-specific summary counts. Bottom navigation has five destinations. Separate shared-footer About & contact entry opens its independent page.

screens.title: My Guns
screens.notes: Illustrated per-gun cards show readiness, selection and capacity. Separate Select, Edit and Delete actions; confirmed single-gun deletion removes all its owned sounds/calibration/presets/settings/recognition/session data atomically. Preserve other guns/device preferences, choose the oldest remaining gun when deleting selection, or open setup after the last gun. Cancel changes nothing; active/unsaved work locks actions.

screens.title: Learn Sounds
screens.entry: Learn tab, Home card or missing-sound link
screens.notes: Primary Trigger training card; optional Draw/Rack/Magazine disclosure with per-label recognition controls; optional reset/noise/external-beep calibration disclosure. Preview, Train, Test and confirmed per-category Reset are distinct. Three compatible samples are required; 8–10 recommended. New recordings stop at ten per gun/type/category; older over-cap data remains. Capture asks for safety first.

states.label: Preserved old profile above the new cap

screens.title: Drills
screens.entry: Drills tab, Home card or review completion
screens.notes: Six practice cards precede the preserved sequence catalog. Built-in / Custom tabs select sequence presets. The inline custom editor has a title, ordered action list, add/remove/reorder controls, Save and Cancel. A preset is owned by the active gun and uses the existing four event identifiers. The editor is a screen state, not another public route.

screens.title: Practice
screens.entry: Six mode cards or saved practice review in History
screens.notes: Configure exposes only mode-relevant count/duration/par/endpoints, app/external start source, fixed/random delay, beep and readiness. Single defaults to ten automatic repetitions with fresh random 2–5-second countdown/signal/first accepted trigger each time. Running uses STOP and the microphone meter below when capture is live; Pause releases capture. Par/Reload offer Next between resolved attempts; repeated/control/free remain continuous. Review shows saved outcomes and Repeat / Back to Drills. Histories use actual previous-screen Back and never restart capture on refresh.
additionalStates: External-cue waiting; live input until calibrated cue starts timing
Finishing a deadline; late events rejected by onset time
Saving error; Retry and navigation recovery guard

screens.title: Drill Session
screens.entry: Start Drill on a built-in/custom sequence, or History review
screens.notes: Keep the ordered sequence visible once. Configure exposes repetitions (default ten), fixed/random delay (default fixed three seconds), Sound at start (default Off), readiness and Start Session. Require only referenced sound types. Run shows completed/left, countdown/GO, latest repetition and Pause/Resume/End. Legacy GO is a status; the Practice STOP correction does not replace this runner. Each ordered completion is saved and followed by a fresh countdown. Review shows totals and repetition/split details, Repeat Session and Back to Drills.

screens.title: Live Listen
screens.entry: Live Listen tab, Home card or Start free listening
screens.notes: Free-listening/sequence selection, current event and score, level/waveform, single sound test and continuous Start/Stop controls. Continuous capture remains active through separate events until stopped or left. Unknown input stays transient; accepted known results can be verified in History. Microphone level does not establish that a click was recognized.

screens.title: History
screens.notes: Per-gun session statistics/chart/table and saved practice/sequence Reviews. Distinct confirmed Clear saved sessions removes this gun’s durable results/progress; Clear recognition history removes only its recent-event rows and refreshes recognition statistics, prediction and Live Listen log/counts. Both update immediately, preserve other data/guns and support cancellation. Deleted Review routes resolve to Drills; stale reads cannot repaint deleted records.

screens.title: Settings
screens.entry: Settings gear in each screen heading; backup/restore links
screens.notes: Distinct confirmed selected-gun sound reset with visible learned/calibration counts and result; whole-library backup export/import; supported per-gun Noise Filter/Auto Gain and device-wide themes/vibration. A separate Delete all guns & app data action states every store deleted, recommends exporting first, and requires confirmation before atomic reset/restart. Cancel deletes nothing. Sound reset retains guns, presets/results and other guns. Unsupported capabilities are disclosed; Install explains local-data and microphone limits. Device capability status stays in Settings; About is reached independently from the shared app footer.

screens.title: About
screens.entry: Shared app footer → About, including before gun setup
screens.notes: Dedicated informational screen with canonical logo/name, proposed current-feature copy, local storage/backup and safety/recognition limits. Contact has its own screen. Both centered footer controls remain visible with current-page indication, muted color and divider. Back/Forward works without a saved gun; no capture, safety acknowledgement or data changes. Practice navigation and gun switcher are hidden.

screens.title: Contact
screens.entry: Shared app footer → Contact, including before gun setup
screens.notes: Independent email/contact screen with selectable confirmed mailto address, accessible without a gun or microphone. Preserves history, appearance, data and safety state. Both centered muted footer controls remain available with a divider below; gun switching/practice tabs/safety disclosure are hidden.

shared.title: Safety confirmation
shared.entry: Any unconfirmed action that would acquire microphone capture
shared.notes: Native accessible modal with explicit safety text, acknowledgement checkbox, disabled Confirm & continue until checked and Cancel. Confirm resumes the original action exactly once; Cancel or changed context does not start capture. Acknowledgement is page-session-local, resets on refresh or gun change, and is never a permanent waiver. The disclosure remains available for reviewing the checklist.
